summary: Staff sign-in of the admin application, one document at /ghost/ with hash routes. A script handler submits the form. Release 6.69.0 ships two layouts of the screen (Ember and React) with the same field ids and names; the server's public site data decides which one is shown.

staysInteractive.note: A sign-in from a new device, or on a site that requires 2FA, continues on the verify route with a code sent by email.
An account flagged for a password reset is shown a notice instead of being signed in.

schemaGaps: The admin is one document at /ghost/ and its screens are hash routes. The format cannot gate on the fragment, so the sign-in, sign-up, setup and reset screens cannot be told apart by path. The steps are safe only because the password and submit selectors require the identification field, which the other screens do not have.

A site installed in a sub-directory has the admin at that prefix followed by ghost/. The format has no path-suffix or installation-relative gate, so only an installation at the host root is covered. Under a sub-directory nothing is filled.
notes: Field ids, names and types are identical in the Ember template of 5.82.0, 5.130.5, 6.0.0 and 6.40.0 (file ghost/admin/app/templates/signin.hbs, read at those tags on 2026-10-12). The React screen was not in the releases read before 6.69.0. Releases before 5.82.0 were not read. Member sign-in on the public site is a different page and is not covered.
